description: Approved envelope for store-beta: a store-wide floor of 40.00 with one product carrying a tighter floor of its own. Pins that a floor with no product_ref applies to every product, and that the two floors compose to the stricter of the pair.
approved_by: merchant onboarding approval; the second approved envelope exists so the store-wide-floor branch is graded against data rather than only against store-alpha's per-product floors

discount_expectations.note: lands exactly on the store-wide floor at exactly the cap; both walls may be reached
48.00 lands exactly on this product's own tighter floor
47.40 clears the 40.00 store-wide floor and is nowhere near the 50% cap, yet is refused: the product's own 48.00 floor is the stricter of the two and binds
36.00 — under both floors, and still inside the 50% cap: depth alone never tells you whether a request is allowed
